event.title: Sazabi announced $8M seed round
event.summary: Sazabi announced it had raised an $8M seed round led by J2 Ventures, @villageglobal and @ycombinator, with participation from @orangecollectv and over 60 angel investors from leading AI, developer tools, and infrastructure companies such as Vercel, Cursor, LangChain, OpenAI.
